missing_information_behavior: Do not issue a recommendation until bleeding history, medication list, surgery timing and product EPA/DHA dose are clarified.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume all algal products contain the same EPA/DHA profile.
Do not advise stopping prescribed anticoagulants or antiplatelets.
Do not overstate bleeding risk at ordinary dietary doses.
professional_escalation_conditions: Active bleeding, bleeding disorder, anticoagulant/antiplatelet use or planned surgery.
High-dose EPA/DHA or significant cardiovascular history.
population_and_context: Users considering algal DHA/EPA products who report bleeding disorders or upcoming surgery; product EPA/DHA content and medication use are relevant.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; assess actual EPA/DHA amount and clinician-directed perioperative guidance.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet summarizes safety and interactions; risk varies by dose and clinical context, and surgical decisions belong to the treating team.
